paragraphs: Subject: A weekly plan for you and me. Dear Ravi, Hello from Thailand! How are you and your class? I have a smart idea, and I want to tell you the details. Do not worry, it is not a joke this time. Mia says that my jokes are bad, but she always laughs. It is a real plan, and Teacher Kim likes it too.

My idea is a weekly swap. Lily writes to Grace, and Mia writes to Nadia. I want to try something new with you. Every week, I will send you one cartoon. Every week, you will send me one recipe, because you love food. Your recipes are my favorite part of your emails. We can put them on a class page on the web. Teacher Kim says that a class page is easy to make.

This is the plan for each week, in order. The plan has four steps, and time is important in each step. On Monday, I draw the cartoon at school. On Wednesday, I send the cartoon to you by email. On Friday, you read it and send me a recipe. On the next Monday, I read your recipe and show it to my friends. Then Chef Lucy tells us if the recipe is easy to cook. The first cartoon is about a frog that cannot swim.

Now, here are the details of the technology. I use a free drawing software on the school computer. I draw with a mouse, and sometimes my lines go the wrong way. The software is smart, because it can fix a wrong line. It makes the lines smooth, and the colors are bright. The cartoon file is small, so the email is fast. Please send your recipe as a short text, and not as a big file. Then I can put it on the page without a problem. May says that the page is safe, because only our classes can see it. Teacher Kim reads each message before I send it.

What do you think of the plan? Is Friday a good day for you? Please tell me the details of your week, and I will change the plan. Write back soon, and tell me about the food of your family. I hope that you say yes. I will send the first cartoon on Wednesday if you say yes. Your friend, Leo.
text.summary: Leo writes an email to his pen pal Ravi with a weekly plan. Leo sends a cartoon each week, Ravi sends a recipe, and the days and the technology are explained in time order.
